sources.title: Telemanom-ESA | kplabs-pl/ESA-ADB | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Telemanom-ESA is a modified implementation of the Telemanom (Telemetry Anomaly Monitor) algorithm, originally developed for NASA spacecraft monitoring. It uses LSTM neural networks to model normal behavior in multivariate time series and detects anomalies by identifying deviations from predicted values.
